summary: SAIHEAT Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting that all shareholder proposals were adopted at its extraordinary general meeting held on August 26, 2026. The filing includes the fifth and sixth amended and restated memorandum and articles of association and the voting results. The amendments adjust authorized share capital to include class A, convertible class B, and preference shares. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is procedural, reflecting ordinary charter amendments and meeting results, with no deal terms or strategic transaction.
